change.after: "embedded cache enabled if no other cache is explicitly enabled"

consequence.statement: Deployments that do not explicitly enable any cache will now have the embedded cache enabled after upgrading.
consequence.remediation: Check the cache configuration and explicitly enable the cache you want if the embedded cache is not desired.

assertion.statement: In Loki 3.0.0, the embedded cache is turned on when no other cache is explicitly enabled.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence does not name the config key (or keys) that controls the embedded cache, or which caches this applies to, so the subject cannot be pinned to an exact identity.; applicability: Exposure means no other cache is explicitly enabled, but the evidence does not name the cache settings, so no predicate can be written.
